appearance.subtle: One of their fingers is noticeably newer than the others.
appearance.obvious: Two fingers on their off hand are pale, soft and undersized, clearly regrown.
appearance.extreme: Their left arm is visibly younger than the rest of them, hairless and pink from the elbow down, and it does not match.

description: Specialised regeneration, tuned to limbs. Fingers come back. Given long enough and enough food, so does more than that.
drawbacks: The new part is never quite the old part
name: Limb Regrowth
